queries_run: TSMC Apple Nvidia customer revenue concentration 10-K 2026
TSMC customer concentration risk disclosure top customer percent revenue
S&P Global Ratings Nvidia upgraded AA- date

findings.claim: TSMC's ten largest customers accounted for 78% of FY2025 net revenue, up from 76% in FY2024; the single largest customer accounted for roughly 19% of FY2025 revenue (up from 12% in FY2024).
findings.source: TSMC 2025 Annual Report (20-F) customer concentration disclosure, summarized by StockTitan (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/TSM/20-f-taiwan-semiconductor-manufacturing-co-ltd-files-annual-report-fo-e7792df70159.html) and ExploreSemis (https://exploresemis.substack.com/p/tsmcs-top-10203040-customers-who)

findings.claim: Nvidia overtook Apple to become TSMC's largest customer in FY2025 (~19% of revenue, up from 12% in FY2024), while Apple's share fell to ~17% from 22%.
findings.source: MacRumors, "Nvidia Overtakes Apple as TSMC's Biggest Customer" (https://www.macrumors.com/2026/01/28/nvidia-replaces-apple-as-biggest-tsmc-customer/); CNBC (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/01/26/nvidia-set-to-supplant-apple-as-tsmcs-largest-customer.html)

findings.claim: S&P Global Ratings upgraded Nvidia's credit rating from 'AA-' to 'AA', citing strong AI-driven growth; this follows an earlier upgrade from 'A+' to 'AA-' on 2024-04-30. TSM's largest customer's credit profile is strengthening, not deteriorating.
findings.source: S&P Global Ratings, "Nvidia Corp. Upgraded To 'AA' On Strong AI-Driven..." (https://www.spglobal.com/ratings/en/regulatory/article/-/view/type/HTML/id/3579353); Yahoo Finance (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/p-global-ratings-upgrades-nvidia-211417548.html)

customer_concentration_credit.note: No evidence found of credit-rating downgrades, bankruptcy risk, or balance-sheet stress at TSM's major customers (Apple, Nvidia, AMD) in 2026; items surfaced under 'downgrade' searches were sell-side stock analyst rating changes, not credit-agency actions, and were not treated as findings.
